title: Pointwise composition law for structure-sheaf cohomology pullback
statement: For composable scheme morphisms f : X ⟶ Y and g : Y ⟶ Z, every n and every x : Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb Z) n, structureSheafCohomologyPullback (f ≫ g) n x = structureSheafCohomologyPullback f n (structureSheafCohomologyPullback g n x).

proof.text: Unfold the Ext-defined pullback. The comparison isomorphisms for inverse images and constant sheaves are compatible with composition; naturality of Ext maps and associativity of Yoneda products identify the composite pullback with the pullback along f ≫ g, evaluated at x.
